title: Continuous span and shape across torque budgets 0.5-2 N·m at 1.25 Hz, 0.5 mm FAAV sheet
author: sam
question: At 1.25 Hz, where every current top FAAV wing sits, only the 1 N·m budget has been searched with a 200 mm root. With half-span free, how do the best thrust, half-span and outline change with torque budget from 0.5 to 2 N·m?
notes: The 1 Hz budget sweep (2026-11-25-free-span-budgets) repeated at 1.25 Hz, with 1 N·m added: same FAAV boundary condition (0.5 mm sheet pivoting on a stiff leading edge), 200 mm root, twelve lineages per budget (concave, convex and triangle seeds at 250, 350, 450 and 550 mm), half-span a search coordinate (20 mm step) between 150 and 800 mm, chord step 20 mm. Manufacturing: a single sheet is at most 400 mm; not a search limit, shaded in the atlas.
